note: Private GTR Seeds / Oregon CBD sample. Seed-matrix CoAs transcribed from PREE Laboratories South PDFs in GTR's public Drive Seed COA folder (Double Durban.pdf C231203-41, Garlic Berry.pdf C231203-42). Not finished flower. Not a public genetics library.
provenance_warning: These COA's were taken from plants 30 days pre-harvest as required by the US Department of Agriculture, and are not an accurate representation of finished flower cannabinoid content. Separately: the two certificates ingested here are Seed COAs (matrix hemp / photograph of seeds), informational use only. They are not 30-day pre-harvest flower panels and they do not support GTR's commercial claim of up to 10% THCV and 10% THC in finished flower. GTR states they do not post finished-flower results.

method.decarboxylation_note: total_thc = d9_THC + THCA * 0.877. total_thcv = THCV + THCVA * 0.877. Δ8-THC is recorded when present and is not added to total THC.
method.verification: Garlic Berry published total THC 3.374% recomputes to 3.373% from THCA 3.49 + d9-THC 0.313. Double Durban lists every named cannabinoid including THCV as <LOQ 0.010%; no THCV total can be derived.
